title: A directional view of policy value
text: Global Policy Value Optimizer brings asset assumptions, global policy exposure, and decision-ready recommendations into one governed workspace.
points: Designed for pipeline asset reviews and development decisions.
Directional assessment, separate from downstream quantitative forecast modelling.

title: How it works
text: Four steps. Work in order, or return to any finished step.
points: Submit inputs › Review › Eligibility › Impact & actions
AI first pass — Reads documents, suggests values and answers
You decide — Accept, change or add before use

title: Where the data comes from
points: Program setup — Asset, modality, route, class, indications
Documents — Competitive Intelligence, Trial Protocol Concept Sheet, CDP, Forecast Assumptions
Extracted fields — Source, confidence, policies fed
Revenue forecast — Illustrative baseline from your forecast file

title: Reading the results
text: Illustrative. Not a forecast or advice.
points: Eligibility — Pass = in scope. Open a check for its source.
Revenue at risk — Lifetime revenue a policy may remove.
Waterfall — Gross to net to mitigated. Scenarios rescale it.
Sensitivity — Inputs ranked by impact, Low to High.

title: Monitor new policy documents
text: Source pipelines check the official policy websites and list new policy documents for IRA, MFN, JCA and EU-GPL.
points: Each document has a link to the source and a short AI summary.
The list is read-only; rules and assessments do not change automatically.

title: Browse the policy rules
text: The Rules Engine lists the current active rules from the policy framework, policy by policy.
points: Open a rule to see its citation and the official source document.
